basis: Assumed ready-to-eat recipes, not restaurant recipe cards. Nutrients per full serving. Trace=0. Source carbohydrate uses monosaccharide equivalents; sucrose model uses mass-based 100 g/400 kcal. Calorie rounding to nearest 5; macros to 0.1 g. Compote: 14 g total sugar per 200 g. Garnish/hot/sauce: 150/100/50 g. Bone-free edible meat assumption. Cream-based proxy for sour cream; roasted thigh proxy for smoked chicken. Herbs/spices negligible.
